Additional features include a Rinnai tankless propane water heater, hurricane window protection, Generac generator backfeed connection, one-car garage with dedicated workshop space, and infrastructure planned for a future elevator installation. Horlbeck Creek is a small, quiet community with convenient access to Mount Pleasant Towne Centre, Highway 17, I-526, Isle of Palms, and the beach, along with nearby access to Brickyard's walking paths. For buyers looking for newer construction without sacrificing a private backyard, pool, or established Mount Pleasant setting, this home brings those elements together in one exceptionally livable property.

The spacious primary suite is located on the main level and features a walk-in closet along with a private ensuite bath complete with a walk-in shower. Two additional bedrooms, a second full bath, and a utility room provide comfortable accommodations for guests, family, or flexible living needs. Constructed with durable HardiPlank siding, slab foundation, attached garage, and welcoming front porch, this move-in ready home was designed for easy maintenance and everyday comfort. Residents of Planter's Row at Palmetto Crossing enjoy desirable amenities including gated entry, community pool access, jogging paths, streetlights, and the charm of a connected lake community atmosphere - all located just minutes from Greenwood's shopping, dining, healthcare, and entertainment. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, a second home near the water, or a place to embrace a slower pace surrounded by the beauty of Lake Greenwood, 315 Indigo Way offers the perfect opportunity to enjoy curated lake living in one of the area's most desirable communities.
